messages:
alex_partnerships: Hey team — attaching Apex Edge solution brief + hero tiles. Need final logo lockup, legal signoff on the customer quote, and confirmation that the marketplace tile meets AWS/GC marketplace requirements. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/Abc123/apex-edge-assets. Files in /shared/partnerships/apex-edge/ (PDF + SVGs). Thanks!

asset-bot: Uploaded 3 files to /shared/partnerships/apex-edge/ — apex_solution_brief_v3.pdf, apex_logos_2026.zip, marketplace_tiles.png

mike_design: Quick look — brief looks great. Two asks: can we get SVGs for the mono white lockup? Current `apex_logos_2026.zip` has only PNGs. Also can we swap the orange CTA to Redwood marigold hex #FF9F3B?

sara_pm: Timeline note — marketing needs final assets by EOD Thu to hit marketplace publish next Tue. If legal needs more time, we may need to push.

linda_legal: Saw the customer quote on pg 2. Needs consent from Apex Systems (they used initials). @jordan_cs can you confirm we've got written permission to publish full quote? Also trademark note: Apex requests their ® next to their logo; include trademark guidance doc: https://internal.redwood/legal/trademark-guidance.

jordan_cs: Confirmed — we have an email from Apex legal (sent 2026-03-18) that okayed the quote but asked to change 'their' to 'Apex Systems' full name. I'll upload the signed quote with timestamp.

mike_design: Also, marketplace tile sizing — AWS tile requires 600x300 PNG and <200kb. Current tile is 1200x600 at 540kb. I'll create export presets and re-upload.

alex_partnerships: Two brand questions: co-brand lockup — can Redwood logo sit left of Apex or does Apex require center alignment? Apex brand guide says 'lockup preferred with partner on right' but we historically do left — can design make both options? Also need alt text for accessibility for both tiles.

mike_design: I'll produce both lockups. For alt text I'd suggest: 'Apex Systems and Redwood Inference solution brief — scalable LLM inference for enterprises.' Any edits?

sara_pm: That's concise. Add 'with enterprise SLAs' at end maybe. So: 'Apex Systems and Redwood Inference solution brief — scalable LLM inference for enterprises with enterprise SLAs.'

mike_design: updated alt text noted.

linda_legal: Also flag: Apex's legal asks that case study customer name be pseudonymized unless they sign an NDA addendum. Is this a case study or solution brief? If case study, we need addendum.

alex_partnerships: This is a solution brief (no PII case details), but we referenced a 'customer success' quote. Jordan will verify addendum not needed.

jordan_cs: Uploaded `apex_quote_signed.pdf` to the folder. Quote uses full company name and includes permission for brief and marketplace listing. No addendum needed.

mike_design: Re-uploaded assets: apex_logos_vector.zip (contains .svg and .eps), marketplace_tile_600x300.png (168kb), marketplace_tile_600x300@2x.png (336kb), and a 72dpi hero. Also attached co-brand-left.png and co-brand-right.png.

alex_partnerships: Perfect. Last ask — can we get a one-sentence partner blurb for the marketplace listing? Suggest: 'Apex Systems and Redwood Inference deliver optimized LLM inference for regulated enterprises.'

jordan_cs: Customer okayed that blurb.

sara_pm: I'll slot this into the publish schedule. Final checklist: logos (vector) ✅, quote signed ✅, legal OK ✅, marketplace tile ✅, alt text ✅. :tada:

mike_design: I'll update the solution brief PDF with final assets and push v4 by noon.

asset-bot: Versioned file created: apex_solution_brief_v4.pdf (sha256: abcdef123456...), uploaded at 2026-04-02T16:20:00Z
